scope: I02-I08 exact matched case block including every shared seed/concern, raw/convergence, summary, optional addition and prior-ID disposition. Not a full Robot Talks evaluation.
row_identity: Blinded packet expected_matrix declares exact row IDs. Every identity once; no omissions of empty/invalid/skipped units. Prefix raw/summary IDs with opaque unit ID. All case-local raw card pairs and raw×ordinary-archive pairs explicit. Semantic equivalence disputes remain uncertain, never scalar-adjudicated into forced families.
raw_qualification: Same frozen criteria scalar meanings: intelligible true, novelty new, usefulness>=1, observability2, fit preserves, support not unsupported, contract met, family_confirmed true, independently resolved. Feasible probe resources must be source-supported; no physical/human measured success inferred. Shared seed/concern can establish overlap but is not attributed as treatment discovery.
protected_retention: Relation and full prediction/probe including all rivals, directional comparisons, challenge/defeat and capacity/resource caveats; uncertainty and declared fit. Summaries may have six post cards per two raw cards; evaluate all post IDs, every raw source and exact lineage. Faithful inherited raw errors are separate from new summary assertions. Park/reject disposition may preserve protected content in its reason; absent targets alone do not prove loss.
unit_contract: Apply only the assigned per-unit instruction; ordinary/generic controls are not required to perform the treatment. Honest no viable opening is a valid execution result, not a discovery or zero-valued missing assessment. Distinguish raw completeness from summary completeness.
family_assessment: Judge all explicit archive/candidate pairs from causal operation, carrier/path and prediction/test, not words. family_confirmed only if relevant comparisons resolve. Same-family overlap prevents exclusivity even if comparator fit/contract is partial. Preserve uncertain links and no forced transitive merges.

burden.prospective_change: I05 maximal complete matrix exceeds200 obligations at max6 summaries and max2 additions per arm; provide6000 before any scored generation, retain original allowance and first blocked preflight. All arms/reviewers identical; actual cost reported. Native unscored maximal matrix still required before admission.
burden.shard: one complete case block per independent review
burden.review_calls: two per case, one bounded scalar adjudicator maximum; no retries

adjudication: Exact differences of scalar grades only; freeze agreed scalars. Pair/family differences retain uncertain; no family merges. One native scalar-only turn per case max. Invalid review and dependency skips keep source IDs and null judgments, never zero novelty.
phase_gate: Own-study pilot findings must be locked before confirmation. Negative/unresolved outcomes are preserved and can be confirmed where portfolio allows; explicit eliminate/stop rules dispose dependent roles as skipped. No output-conditioned case selection.
